release_notes:
- Group sync now stays in step when boards are parked, braking or blinking. Previously a board sitting still could stop following the group after a minute or so until it was power-cycled.
- Changes made in the app while the group's lead board is parked now reach the rest of the group.
- Brake lights, turn signals and park mode still take over the lights while active; when they end, the board shows the group's current look.
